answer: Miscellaneous >> History & Biography Question ID: 6396 Country: India Title: Where hazrat ali (rali) did and where he is burried? Plz give me detailz. Question: Where hazrat ali (rali) did and where he is burried? Plz give me detailz. Answer ID: 6396 Posted on: Dec 18, 2023 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 789/727=L/1429) Hadhrat Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) passed away in Kufa albeit there are different opinions regarding his burial place. Some say that since the rioters were very mischievous, therefore his burial was made in secrecy. According to Hafiz ibn Kasir, the acceptable and reliable sources indicate that he was buried secretly inside the capital Kufa while some Shiah say that the grave of Hadthrat Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) is in Najaf. Besides this, there are several opinions concerning the burial of Hadhtrat Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) (Al-Bidaya w Al- Nihaya, 329/33). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
